notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.notes:
1.2.2:
- fixed save/load menu navigation with controller when accessed from dialogue
- fixed dialogue not being responsive after closing menu with controller

PS: If you happened to notice 1.2.1.2 several minutes ago, I mistakenly uploaded the build without the full fix

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
1.2.1:
- fixed "Windowed" mode on Steam Deck
- further UI adjustements for readability on smaller screens and controller navigation
- added left controller joystick to some UI navigation in addition to D-Pad
- adjusted UI navigation in sex scenes with controller

As always, let me know if you find any issues!

notes.title: Patch 1.04.3 - 24 November
notes.notes:
This tiny patch fixes a rare issue when a selfie is not unlocked.
You can safely load the affected save and the missing selfie should appear. Achievement should unlock.

I also implemented a tiny failsafe by disabling any input on scene change, that might have been the cause.

Let me know if you encounter any issues!

notes.title: 1.04.2 - "Patching patch"
notes.notes:
I heard you like patches, so here's a patch to patch the previous patch that was supposed to patch another thing I hoped I already patched. Patch.

In seriousness, it seems like dialogue logic handling rewrites worked well, but loading got back to the start of the scene instead of the specific line you saved at, so I managed to restore that feature to fit new logic. Hopefully I didn't break anything else in the process.

As usual, let me know if anything breaks for you and I'll try looking into it :)

notes.title: Patching the patch - 1.04.1
notes.notes:
Thanks to sending me your saves, I managed to find a workaround, hopefully.
I just rewrote part of dialogue handling logic.

I hope it doesn't break anything, but from my quick testing it seems it works as it should and doesn't throw errors.

notes.title: Patch 1.04 / 30 September
notes.notes:
This patch should hopefully fix the edge-cases of game crashing when dialogue should be played, occurring for example when reaching highest level or changing clothes.

The issue was caused by save bugging out and dialogue system had no clue what to do. The solution I implemented should remove all instances of those once you enter the main, action selection screen. It will force-overwrite session data, clearing dialogue position that for some reason did not reset as it should after the end of an event.

notes.title: Patch Notes for September 28
notes.notes:
- fixed scaling on resolutions higher than 1920x1080, removing strong pixelation
- capped FPS to 60 - should reduce coil whine on some hardware

notes.title: Update 1.03 / Sep 20
notes.notes:
This version fixes an issue with game breaking on clothes change. This error was affecting only a few users, so most of you probably didn't feel it. I don't know what the cause was- Well, I do know, the save data was wonky, but I don't know how it happened, my guess is... clicking too fast past dialogue and the system didn't register it properly. Anyway, the fix is rather crude and technically ugly, but it works if you have save affected by this.

In other news, I added a "Hide UI" button to sex scenes. You could have hidden it with the middle mouse button but apparently, a visual on-screen button is more obvious.

You can now check the version number on the "Credits" page from the main menu (panel displays on the right). Should state 1.03 under the title.

I hope that's all for this game and I can focus on the next ones. If you happen to encounter anything else, just let me know!

notes.title: Update Note for September 13th
notes.notes:
Fixed coffee purchase bug.

Let me know if you encounter anything else.

notes.title: Day 0 Patch
notes.notes:
As you noticed, this kind of game has several various systems and it's cobbled together with duct tape and hopes. (In seriousness, it's quite a fancy system I designed from scratch).

As such, bugs are unfortunately possible, but I see your feedback and try to fix it ASAP. I do my best to minimize errors, but while testing, I often check something, then change a small portion of code later and assume that I didn't break that small thing... but it happened in this case.

This quick patch fixes and/or changes the following:
- missing references to scenes after purchasing sex gadgets causing pink screen and test line
- more "proper" window management, which should start as half of your resolution by default on the center of the native monitor instead of a predefined setting
- disabled debug mode (I think)
- updated engine version. While this might bring issues on its own, it should make the game more stable and from my quick testing I didn't find game-breaking issues, but keep me posted

As for the progression error two users reported, I cannot replicate it and don't know the cause of it yet. My guess is clicking too fast thus not registering events properly, but I don't know how to solve it yet.

If there are more issues, let me know! The best way would be to write in Community Hub as I get notification for each post - https://steamcommunity.com/app/3136020
